label: Applying to an Estonian institution for autumn 2027

milestones.label: Tallinn University: bachelor's applications close
milestones.note: One university's date, and the only 2027 one published so far. Four months before IB results.

milestones.label: Academy of Music and Theatre: 2027 dates
milestones.note: The Academy says it will publish them in December 2026.

milestones.label: Every other institution: its own closing date
milestones.note: Sharing the DreamApply portal does not mean sharing a deadline. For 2026 entry EUAS kept EU applications open until 20 September; TalTech's 2025 bachelor round closed on 1 June. Check each programme page from late 2026.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: After Tallinn University's deadline. Ask each institution how it treats results that arrive after you apply.

supplementarySteps: Most institutions share one DreamApply account at estonia.dreamapply.com. Tallinn Health University of Applied Sciences and the Baltic Methodist Theological Seminary take applications on their own sites.
Each institution sets its own deadline, fee, test and decision. Read the programme page, not the portal.

notes: Channel is 'direct' although nine institutions share a portal: the portal publishes no common deadline or decision, so it is a shared front door rather than a central admission.

Not established: 2027 dates at the University of Tartu, TalTech and the Estonian University of Life Sciences. All three sites return 403 to automated requests and put a bot-check page in front of a browser, so none was read.
